items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: One of them was Ben Johnson, he was a bass guitar and piano player... Then my brother, Ben, came through there... with T. Holder.

ctx.x: Well, I was maybe about twelve, twelve or thirteen, something like that.

Anyway, I wanted to play music, because my brother... I had three half-brothers, all of them played music. One of them was Ben Johnson, he was a bass guitar and piano player. My older brother, Joe, was a pianist, and my younger brother, Cesar Johnson, was a guitarist. So they were all that I knew about, you know. So I was thinking about really playing music. And that's how I got into it. So I after I went up to Bristow and so forth, and...
